$comment: Facts the North Star needs that no agent can establish. A fact is UNKNOWN until a person attests it (autonomy/attestations.jsonl, written only by `npm run attest`, which refuses to run without a human at a terminal). A few facts also have a MACHINE check: a record the repository can see. A machine check can make a fact MACHINE_VERIFIED, but a fact with machine_check null can only ever become HUMAN_VERIFIED or HUMAN_REFUTED. This file is L3 (autonomy/policy.json): an agent that could edit it could redefine what 'verified' means. Deployment facts that IT supplies (hostname, boot start, backups of the VM) live in the deployment model (deployment/facts.mjs, `npm run deployment-gate`), not here; this file does not duplicate them.

states.UNKNOWN: nobody has attested it and nothing the repository can see establishes it
states.HUMAN_VERIFIED: a named person attested it is true, on a date
states.HUMAN_REFUTED: a named person checked and attested it is NOT true; a negative result, not an absence
states.MACHINE_VERIFIED: a record in this repository establishes it (only for facts with a machine_check)

facts.statement: The Lippolis purchasing baseline was observed and frozen (npm run baseline:freeze) BEFORE any real purchase was processed in PCC.
facts.why: A baseline cannot govern work that predates it. Purchases processed before it exists are permanently unvaluable, and the first real measured business outcome depends on this. docs/proof/BASELINE_DAY.md, docs/proof/FIRST_REAL_PROOF_ACTIVATION.md.
facts.evidence_hint: path of the frozen record under proof/baselines/frozen/ and the date of the first real PCC purchase

facts.statement: scripts/preflight-windows.ps1 on LIPELE-RDS02 reported READY TO INSTALL with 0 blockers.
facts.why: Every Windows-specific prerequisite (Node 24, NSSM, IIS/ARR, paths, permissions) is checked only on the real server. No CI run can prove it.

facts.statement: PCC is installed on LIPELE-RDS02 from a hash-verified PCC-<commit>.zip, and `node scripts/pcc-verify-deployment.mjs --service pcc` reports READY FOR ACCEPTANCE TESTING.
facts.why: works_in_production starts here. Nothing measurable happens before it.

facts.statement: The PO sequence was initialized from the paper history before the first live PO (PCC_RDS02_EXECUTION_PACKAGE.md section 2), or it was confirmed that no prior sequence exists.
facts.why: A PO number that collides with a paper PO is a real-world error the system cannot detect after the fact.

facts.statement: On LIPELE-RDS02, install-backup-task.ps1 -Verify shows the task enabled with last result 0, and `pcc-backup.mjs --check` reports verified with counts.
facts.why: CI proves the backup tool works. Only the server proves the backup is scheduled, runs as the right account, and lands on storage that is itself backed up.

facts.statement: On LIPELE-RDS02, a real backup was restored to a scratch path with pcc-restore.mjs and reported its requests readable (proof register step 17).
facts.why: A backup nobody has restored is a hope. CI restores in containers; the server's paths, permissions and service account are only proven there.

facts.statement: After a reboot of LIPELE-RDS02, the pcc service came back on its own and the verifier still reports READY.
facts.why: The runbook calls this 'the one that cannot be inferred'. No container test can stand in for a Windows service at boot.

facts.statement: A genuine Lippolis purchase went request → approval → PO → receipt in PCC, in production (PCC_ENVIRONMENT=production), with nobody working around the system.
facts.why: The first production execution; works_in_production moves only on real use.
facts.evidence_hint: request id / PO number, date, people involved, anything they had to work around

facts.statement: At least one discovery interview with a person who does purchasing at a trades business has been recorded.
facts.why: problem_real and customer discovery start at zero without it.
facts.evidence_hint: the interview record imported with npm run evidence -- --import

facts.statement: The hosted Supabase project was checked live and no longer carries the 16 undeclared *_org_* policies on integration_events, time_entry_audits, crews and crew_members.
facts.why: Blocker S1. The cloud environment has no credentials and cannot reach api.supabase.com; only a person can check. Attest HUMAN_REFUTED if the check finds them still present.
facts.evidence_hint: the pg_policies query and its output (no credentials)
